product.title: Nikko World Heritage Private Day Tour w/ English Speaking Driver

description.text: In Tokyo, this private 10-hour charter heads north to Nikko for Toshogu Shrine, Shinkyo Bridge, Kegon Falls, and Lake Chuzenji with an English-speaking driver. Meet-and-greet, highway tolls, and an air-conditioned vehicle are listed for Tokyo 23-ward pickups; meals and some admissions stay separate. The published window is 10 hours from hotel pickup, with overtime listed at 2,500 yen per 30 minutes. Commentary stays on the UNESCO shrine precinct and waterfall approaches rather than a city walking loop. The format suits visitors who want a guided World Heritage day without self-driving the Nikko mountain road. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Tokyo, and the itinerary stays on Toshogu Shrine, Kegon Falls, and Lake Chuzenji that shape this outing rather than a Hakone ropeway add-on.
